page.$description: Page background. Every text token below is measured against it.

surface.$description: Cards, fields and raised panels on the page.

subtle.$description: Hover fill for outline/ghost buttons and unselected tags; alt rows. In dark it sits one step above bg-surface, so a hover on a card shows.

inverse.$description: The inverse block (teal) in both themes: pair with text-on-inverse, brand-label-on-inverse, inverse-action, focus-ring-on-inverse.

default.$description: Body copy on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-subtle (15.18:1 light, cream on slate in dark).

muted.$description: Secondary text on bg-page and bg-surface (6.92:1 light, 6.44:1 dark).

caption.$description: Captions and placeholders on bg-page and bg-surface (4.60:1 light).

heading.$description: Headings on bg-page and bg-surface: plum in light (13.20:1), sage-light in dark (14.03:1).

onBrand.$description: Labels on brand-primary and solid status fills (white, 5.06:1 on orange).

onInverse.$description: Body text on bg-inverse (cream on teal, 9.74:1).

onInverseMuted.$description: Secondary text on bg-inverse (sage-light on teal, 8.34:1).

onInverseAction.$description: Label on inverse-action fills (charcoal, 12.99:1 on sage-light, 15.18:1 on cream).

default.$description: Control borders (fields, tags, theme toggle): the 3:1 hairline.

subtle.$description: Card borders and separators. Decorative, never a control border.

primary.$description: The CTA fill (solid button, selected tag). One per view.

primaryText.$description: Outline button text and border on bg-page and bg-surface (6.16:1 light, 7.12:1 dark).

link.$description: Inline links on bg-page and bg-surface (plum 13.20:1 light, light orange 7.12:1 dark).

linkHover.$description: Link hover on bg-page and bg-surface.

eyebrow.$description: Eyebrow labels on bg-page and bg-surface (plum light, light orange dark).

labelOnInverse.$description: Eyebrow and labels on bg-inverse and plum bands (8.34:1 on teal, 11.3:1 on plum).

decor.$description: Decorative marks only (logo frame, photo border, quotes). Never text.

markFrame.$description: The Mark frame: plum on bg-page (13.20:1), sage-light in dark.

markScript.$description: The Mark signature: orange on bg-page (4.57:1), light orange in dark.

ring.$description: The global focus ring, 2px at 2px offset, on bg-page and bg-surface (13.20:1 light, 7.12:1 dark).

ringOnInverse.$description: Focus ring on bg-inverse and plum bands (sage-light, 8.34:1 on teal).

warning.$description: Solid warning badge fill: carries status-on-warning-solid, never white.

onWarningSolid.$description: Label on a solid warning fill (charcoal, 7.31:1).

neutralSubtle.$description: Soft neutral badge fill; carries status-on-neutral.

onNeutral.$description: Neutral status text: on status-neutral-subtle and as outline text on bg-page.

neutralBorder.$description: Outline neutral badge border on bg-page (3:1).

infoSubtle.$description: Soft info badge fill; carries status-on-info.

onInfo.$description: Info status text: on status-info-subtle and as outline text on bg-page.

infoBorder.$description: Outline info badge border on bg-page (3:1).

successSubtle.$description: Soft success badge fill; carries status-on-success.

onSuccess.$description: Success status text: on status-success-subtle and as outline text on bg-page.

successBorder.$description: Outline success badge border on bg-page (3:1).

warningSubtle.$description: Soft warning badge fill; carries status-on-warning.

onWarning.$description: Warning status text: on status-warning-subtle and as outline text on bg-page.

warningBorder.$description: Outline warning badge border on bg-page (3:1).

dangerSubtle.$description: Soft danger badge fill; carries status-on-danger.

onDanger.$description: Danger status text: on status-danger-subtle and as outline text on bg-page.

dangerBorder.$description: Outline danger badge border on bg-page (3:1).

action.$description: Fill and border of Button inverse / inverse-solid on bg-inverse and plum bands (8.34:1 / 11.29:1).
